global_notice.heading: ASTROCROWN LIVE PUBLIC TEST
global_notice.introduction: You are accessing the AstroCrown public test environment. Public submissions may be visible to anyone on the internet. Anyone who can view a public submission may copy, save, screenshot, quote or redistribute it; removing it from AstroCrown cannot remove copies made elsewhere. Never disclose personal information, production credentials, seed phrases, private keys or wallet recovery secrets.
rules: Only features explicitly marked LIVE are functional, and each LIVE label must identify its environment, such as LIVE · STAGING or LIVE · MAINNET.
DEVNET features operate only on their named development network. Their notice must identify the network and provide its verified test-token faucet link or address. Test tokens have no mainnet value.
FOR DEVELOPMENT · READ ONLY features are previews. They do not provide operational transactions or state-changing functionality.
An unlabelled feature must be treated as FOR DEVELOPMENT · READ ONLY. A wallet connection or off-chain ownership signature does not by itself mean that payments or transactions are enabled.
Anyone who can view a public submission may copy, save, screenshot, quote or redistribute it. Removing it from AstroCrown cannot remove copies made elsewhere.
global_notice.wallet_safety: A wallet ownership message is not a blockchain transaction. Review the exact message shown by your wallet and never disclose a seed phrase, private key or recovery secret. Never approve a token or send assets unless the specific feature is explicitly marked LIVE · MAINNET and you have independently checked the network, asset, amount and destination.
global_notice.acknowledgement: I confirm that I have read and understood this notice, the operational status of this page and the risks associated with using it.

delivery.details: This homepage is reachable through the AstroCrown staging website. This label describes page delivery only; it does not mean that the services or data shown here are operational.

features.name: Market context and market figures
features.details: Displayed market totals, sentiment values, rankings and changes are illustrative. No approved live market-data provider is connected to this page.

features.name: Asset directory and discovery cards
features.details: The current directory uses local sample data. Listings, filters and discovery cards must not be treated as live market coverage or active services.

features.name: AstroCrown wallet-only account creation and sign-in
features.details: The approved primary-wallet identity system is being implemented and qualified. General AstroCrown wallet-only account creation and sign-in are not yet enabled in this staging release.

features.name: AstroCrown Community
features.details: The first-party community implementation remains a development build and is not approved for public operational use.

features.name: Chat with NOVA
features.details: The NOVA-facing member service is not yet operational on this website.

features.name: Council
features.details: Council pages and binding governance actions are not yet operational. Constitutional approval and service qualification are required before activation.

features.name: Trade bots, Swap and Trade
features.details: Trading, bot execution, swap, custody and asset-movement services are not enabled by this page.

delivery.details: The Genesis Programme page is served from the AstroCrown staging website. Page delivery does not imply that payment, purchase or entitlement functions are enabled.

features.name: Genesis primary-wallet identity
features.details: The wallet-native identity and linked-address experience is undergoing exact staging-build and wallet-provider qualification. Do not assume a connection or signature grants payment eligibility.

features.name: Genesis qualifying payments
features.details: Qualifying-payment acceptance is disabled. Do not send USDT or any other asset to a displayed address.

features.name: ACROWN floor-price purchases and delivery
features.details: Purchase quotes, entitlement crediting and ACROWN delivery are not enabled in this staging release.

features.name: Genesis Member qualification and badge
features.details: The badge is awarded only after approved qualification conditions and independently verified final payment evidence. The current preview does not award it.

features.name: Genesis public payment directory
features.details: The directory is an interface and data-model preview; it does not indicate that qualifying payments are being accepted.

delivery.details: The account interface is reachable in the staging website. This does not mean that the approved wallet-only account lifecycle is available.

features.name: Primary-wallet account creation and sign-in
features.details: Wallet-only authentication is the approved account model. Its general account APIs and end-to-end browser flow are not yet qualified for this staging deployment.

features.name: User dashboard and personal profile
features.details: The full wallet-bound member dashboard, profile and connected-wallet experience are still being developed.

features.name: Achievement and badge highlighting
features.details: Badge ownership, highlighting and community display must be backed by the authoritative account and badge registry before activation.

delivery.details: The staging website can serve the administrator interface. This is not an authorization to use operational administrative functions.

features.name: Administrator access and governance controls
features.details: Wallet-primary account integration, owner bootstrap, governance controls and production authorization remain under development and qualification.
